talk: Hello! I am Loremaster Ilse. Let us begin your story.
Click the scroll icon on the right to open your Quest Journal.
This shows your story steps. It always tells you what to do next.
quest_journal.hint: Click the scroll icon on the right side of the screen, then click the first quest step.
complete: Wonderful! You have found your first story step.
The journal now guides you clearly. You are ready for more!

talk: Greetings! I am Prospector Dunn.
Take this pickaxe. Click the copper rock to mine one ore.
We will use this ore to make many things later.
mine_ore.hint: Click the pickaxe icon, then click the copper rock to mine it.
complete: Excellent work! You have gathered your first treasure.
That ore will help you craft great items soon.

talk: Hello there! I am Sergeant Kade.
Click the shirt icon to see your gear, or click the sword in your pack.
Choose Wield to put the sword on your arm.
equip_sword.hint: Click the shirt icon, then click the sword and select Wield.
complete: Perfect! The sword is now ready for your hand.
You look brave and prepared for any adventure.

talk: You seem a little tired. I am Sergeant Kade.
Click the bread in your pack and choose Eat to heal.
Watch the red circle grow as you get stronger.
eat_food.hint: Click the bread item in your pack, then choose Eat to restore health.
complete: Great job! You feel much better now.
Your red circle shows you are full of energy.

talk: Here is a bow and arrows. I am Sergeant Kade.
Wield the bow, then click the rat to shoot it once.
Aim carefully and let the arrow fly!
ranged_shot.hint: Click the bow to wield it, then click the rat to shoot.
complete: Splendid! Your first shot was true and strong.
You are learning to fight from a distance.

talk: This staff holds special power. I am Sergeant Kade.
Wield the staff, then click the rat to cast a spell.
Watch the magic glow as it hits the target.
magic_cast.hint: Click the staff to wield it, then click the rat to cast a spell.
complete: Amazing! You have cast your first spell successfully.
Your magic is growing stronger every day.

talk: Welcome to the safe. I am Banker Corin.
Click the chest, put one item in, and take it back out.
The bank keeps your things safe on the blockchain linked to your wallet.
bank_chest.hint: Click the chest, move an item in, then move it back out.
complete: You have secured your items safely!
The blockchain ensures your things are truly yours.

talk: I am Ledger-keeper Asha. Click the Wallet button to see your address.
Write down your recovery words and never share them.
Items on the chain belong to you. This is a TEST network, so no real money is used yet.
wallet.hint: Click the Wallet button, write down the recovery words, and note the test network status.
complete: Very important! Your wallet is set up correctly.
Your items are safe, and you know how to protect your keys.

talk: Hello! I am Trader Milo.
Click me and choose Trade to buy an item.
Then sell one item back to learn how the market works.
shop.hint: Click the trader, choose Trade, buy an item, then sell an item.
complete: Well done! You have bought and sold your first items.
You now understand how to trade in our world.

talk: Peace be with you. I am Brother Aldo.
Click the bones and choose Bury for Prayer experience.
Open the Prayer button and switch on a prayer to protect yourself.
chapel.hint: Click the bones, choose Bury, then open the Prayer menu and turn on a prayer.
complete: Your spirit is strong now. You have gained prayer power.
May this protection keep you safe in all your quests.
